items.title: The inverse image of a constructible subset along any morphism is constructible
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that the inverse image of a (locally) constructible subset under an arbitrary morphism of schemes is again (locally) constructible (statement lines 4556-4562). The counted proof separates the two notions: for constructible subsets it reduces to retrocompact opens and uses that retrocompactness of an open immersion is quasi-compactness, which survives base change, and for locally constructible subsets it restricts to a pair of affine charts and applies the global case (proof lines 4564-4583). It is H2: the argument is complete in the counted span and the inputs are standard topological and scheme-theoretic criteria.
